title: The city of Nabatieh in Lebanon has been hit hard by Israeli airstrikes
summary: The city of Nabatieh in Lebanon has been hit hard by Israeli airstrikes. "Hezbollah has a strong presence here, this is one of the heartlands of Lebanon's Shia community. Israel says it is targeting fighters who are launching rockets into northern Israel," said FRANCE 24's Claire Paccalin, reporting from the area. Click on the video for more.
